description: This file contains the implementation of the EventHubCheckpointer class and its factory, which manage checkpointing for EventHub partitions in an Orleans streaming application. It includes methods for creating, initializing, loading, and updating checkpoints stored in Azure Table Storage, as well as a factory for creating checkpointer instances.

classes.name: EventHubCheckpointerFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating EventHubCheckpointer instances, managing configuration and dependencies.

classes.name: EventHubCheckpointer
classes.description: Manages checkpoint state for EventHub partitions, storing offsets in Azure Table Storage, with methods for loading and updating checkpoints.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and initializes an EventHubCheckpointer instance asynchronously.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the data manager table for checkpoint storage.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the current checkpoint offset from storage.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the checkpoint offset with throttling to avoid frequent writes.
